name: yosemite-hiking-instagram-shot
image_vibe: Authentic alpine iPhone realism, crisp cool daylight, spontaneous hiking energy
image_purpose: Create a natural Instagram-style travel portrait in Yosemite National Park.

prompt.project_info: A hyper-realistic iPhone photo taken in Yosemite National Park during a real hiking trip.
prompt.main_subject: The approved adult woman from the required face reference stands in the foreground with both feet firmly on the ground, slightly leaning forward, smiling happily and giving a peace/victory sign. Preserve her exact approved facial structure, proportions, and skin texture without beautification. She wears a cropped technical dark-gray hiking jacket with hood down, black fitted shorts, white socks, rugged Salomon trail shoes, and sporty Oakley glasses.
prompt.composition_elements: Slightly imperfect vertical Instagram framing, grounded stance, massive recognizable Yosemite granite cliffs such as El Capitan and Half Dome behind her, wide alpine valley, scattered pine and larch trees, rocky pale gravel terrain, and cinematic mountain depth.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool alpine daylight, crisp natural shadows, realistic rock highlights, light wind moving the jacket, authentic outdoorsy and slightly chaotic mountain mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic iPhone wide-angle photo, vertical social composition, subtle lens distortion, natural skin and fabric texture, no cinematic over-stylization, no branding text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic iPhone photo in Yosemite National Park using the required approved adult face reference. Preserve her exact facial structure, proportions, skin texture, and identity without beautification. She stands in the foreground with both feet firmly on the ground, slightly leaning forward, smiling happily and giving a peace/victory sign. Keep the cropped technical dark-gray hiking jacket with hood down, black fitted shorts, white socks, rugged Salomon trail shoes, and sporty Oakley glasses. Behind her show massive recognizable Yosemite granite cliffs such as El Capitan and Half Dome, a wide alpine valley, pine and larch trees, rocky pale gravel, cool alpine daylight, crisp shadows, realistic highlights, subtle wide-angle distortion, slight wind movement, and authentic hiking-trip energy.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, transparent clothing, altered face, changed outfit, unsafe terrain, fake landmarks, cartoon, CGI, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: approved adult face and outfit reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult face, facial structure, likeness, hairstyle, and reference-specified hiking outfit; do not substitute a celebrity or public figure.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the approved adult reference and keep face, outfit, Yosemite landmarks, grounded pose, and iPhone realism consistent. Non-essential vegetation and framing may vary.

changes: Clarified approved adult reference and preserved the source-specified outfit.
Added safety exclusions without changing the hiking concept.
